original_query: select      cd_gender,     cd_marital_status,     cd_education_status,     hd_vehicle_count,     count(*) as cnt from     store_sales,     web_sales,     date_dim d1,     date_dim d2,     customer,     inventory,     store,     warehouse,     item,     customer_demographics,     household_demographics,     customer_address     where       ss_item_sk = i_item_sk       and ws_item_sk = ss_item_sk       and ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk       and ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk 			and d2.d_date between d1.d_date and (d1.d_date + interval '30' day)       and ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk       and ws_bill_customer_sk = c_customer_sk       and ws_warehouse_sk = inv_warehouse_sk       and ws_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk       and inv_item_sk = ss_item_sk       and inv_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk       and inv_quantity_on_hand >= ss_quantity       and s_state = w_state       AND i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')       and i_manager_id IN (3, 15, 17, 26, 43, 44, 55, 70, 82, 95)       and c_current_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk       and c_current_hdemo_sk = hd_demo_sk       and c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk       and ca_state in ('IN', 'LA', 'NE', 'NM', 'OH')       and d1.d_year = 2001       and ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100     group by cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, hd_vehicle_count     order by cnt     ;
rewritten_query:
WITH filtered_item AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk
    FROM item
    WHERE i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')
      AND i_manager_id IN (3, 15, 17, 26, 43, 44, 55, 70, 82, 95)
),
filtered_date AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2001
),
filtered_web_sales AS (
    SELECT ws_item_sk, ws_warehouse_sk, ws_bill_customer_sk, ws_sold_date_sk
    FROM web_sales
    WHERE ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
),
filtered_customer AS (
    SELECT c_customer_sk, c_current_cdemo_sk, c_current_hdemo_sk, c_current_addr_sk
    FROM customer
    WHERE c_current_addr_sk IN (
        SELECT ca_address_sk
        FROM customer_address
        WHERE ca_state IN ('IN', 'LA', 'NE', 'NM', 'OH')
    )
)
SELECT
    cd_gender,
    cd_marital_status,
    cd_education_status,
    hd_vehicle_count,
    count(*) AS cnt
FROM store_sales
JOIN filtered_item ON ss_item_sk = filtered_item.i_item_sk
JOIN filtered_date d1 ON ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
JOIN inventory ON inv_item_sk = ss_item_sk
    AND inv_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk
    AND inv_quantity_on_hand >= ss_quantity
JOIN warehouse ON inv_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk
JOIN store ON s_state = w_state
JOIN filtered_web_sales ON ws_item_sk = ss_item_sk
    AND ws_warehouse_sk = inv_warehouse_sk
JOIN date_dim d2 ON ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
    AND d2.d_date BETWEEN d1.d_date AND (d1.d_date + interval '30' day)
JOIN filtered_customer ON ss_customer_sk = filtered_customer.c_customer_sk
    AND ws_bill_customer_sk = filtered_customer.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_demographics ON filtered_customer.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk
JOIN household_demographics ON filtered_customer.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd_demo_sk
GROUP BY cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, hd_vehicle_count
ORDER BY cnt;

rewritten_query:
WITH customer_total_return AS (
  SELECT 
    sr_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk,
    sr_store_sk AS ctr_store_sk,
    sr_reason_sk AS ctr_reason_sk,
    SUM(sr_refunded_cash) AS ctr_total_return
  FROM store_returns
  JOIN date_dim ON sr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2001
  WHERE sr_return_amt / sr_return_quantity BETWEEN 236 AND 295
    AND sr_reason_sk BETWEEN 28 AND 31
  GROUP BY sr_customer_sk, sr_store_sk, sr_reason_sk
),
store_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    ctr_store_sk,
    AVG(ctr_total_return) * 1.2 AS avg_threshold
  FROM customer_total_return
  GROUP BY ctr_store_sk
)
SELECT c_customer_id
FROM customer_total_return ctr1
JOIN store_avg sa ON ctr1.ctr_store_sk = sa.ctr_store_sk AND ctr1.ctr_total_return > sa.avg_threshold
JOIN store ON s_store_sk = ctr1.ctr_store_sk AND s_state IN ('MI', 'NC', 'WI')
JOIN customer ON ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c_customer_sk AND c_birth_month = 5 AND c_birth_year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1956
JOIN customer_demographics ON c_current_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk 
  AND cd_marital_status = 'W'
  AND cd_education_status IN ('4 yr Degree', 'College')
  AND cd_gender = 'M'
ORDER BY c_customer_id
LIMIT 100

WITH customer_total_return AS (
  SELECT 
    sr.sr_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk,
    sr.sr_store_sk AS ctr_store_sk,
    sr.sr_reason_sk AS ctr_reason_sk,
    SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS ctr_total_return
  FROM store_returns sr
  JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk

FROM customer_total_return ctr1
JOIN store_thresholds st ON ctr1.ctr_store_sk = st.ctr_store_sk
JOIN store s ON ctr1.ctr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
JOIN customer c ON ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
WHERE ctr1.ctr_total_return > st.threshold
  AND ctr1.ctr_reason_sk BETWEEN 24 AND 27
  AND s.s_state IN ('IA', 'NE', 'TX')

FROM (
  SELECT ss.ss_item_sk, ss.ss_ticket_number, ss.ss_customer_sk
  FROM store_sales ss
  WHERE ss.ss_sales_price / ss.ss_list_price BETWEEN 38 * 0.01 AND 58 * 0.01
) ss
JOIN (
  SELECT sr.sr_item_sk, sr.sr_ticket_number, sr.sr_returned_date_sk
  FROM store_returns sr
) sr ON ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number AND ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk

  SELECT d1.d_date_sk, d1.d_date
  FROM date_dim d1
  WHERE d1.d_year = 2000
) d1 ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
JOIN (
  SELECT i.i_item_sk
  FROM item i
  WHERE i.i_category IN ('Jewelry', 'Music', 'Sports')
) i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN (
  SELECT ws.ws_item_sk, ws.ws_order_number, ws.ws_bill_customer_sk, ws.ws_sold_date_sk
  FROM web_sales ws
) ws ON ss.ss_customer_sk = ws.ws_bill_customer_sk AND sr.sr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk

  SELECT d2.d_date_sk, d2.d_date

) ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN (
  SELECT hd.hd_demo_sk
  FROM household_demographics hd
  WHERE hd.hd_income_band_sk BETWEEN 14 AND 20

) hd ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk

rewritten_query:
WITH filtered_date_dim AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_year = 2002 AND d_moy BETWEEN 3 AND 6
),
filtered_item AS (
  SELECT i_item_sk
  FROM item
  WHERE i_category IN ('Electronics', 'Home', 'Women')
    AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 72 AND 81
),
store_sales_qualified AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ss_customer_sk
  FROM store_sales
  JOIN filtered_date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  JOIN filtered_item ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk
  WHERE ss_sales_price / ss_list_price BETWEEN 0.90 AND 1.00
),
web_sales_qualified AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk
  FROM web_sales
  JOIN filtered_date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  JOIN filtered_item ON ws_item_sk = i_item_sk
  WHERE ws_sales_price / ws_list_price BETWEEN 0.90 AND 1.00
),
catalog_sales_qualified AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT cs_ship_customer_sk AS customer_sk
  FROM catalog_sales
  JOIN filtered_date_dim ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  JOIN filtered_item ON cs_item_sk = i_item_sk
  WHERE cs_sales_price / cs_list_price BETWEEN 0.90 AND 1.00
),
web_or_catalog_qualified AS (
  SELECT customer_sk FROM web_sales_qualified
  UNION
  SELECT customer_sk FROM catalog_sales_qualified
)
SELECT
  cd_gender,
  cd_marital_status,
  cd_education_status,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt1,
  cd_purchase_estimate,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt2,
  cd_credit_rating,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt3,
  cd_dep_count,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt4,
  cd_dep_employed_count,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt5,
  cd_dep_college_count,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt6
FROM customer c
JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
  AND ca.ca_county IN ('Baldwin County', 'Cocke County', 'Elko County', 'Geauga County', 'Marengo County')
JOIN customer_demographics cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
  AND cd.cd_marital_status IN ('U', 'S')
  AND cd.cd_education_status IN ('Advanced Degree', 'Primary')
  AND cd.cd_gender = 'F'
JOIN store_sales_qualified ss_qual ON c.c_customer_sk = ss_qual.ss_customer_sk
JOIN web_or_catalog_qualified wc_qual ON c.c_customer_sk = wc_qual.customer_sk
WHERE c.c_birth_month IN (6, 7)
GROUP BY
  cd_gender,
  cd_marital_status,
  cd_education_status,
  cd_purchase_estimate,
  cd_credit_rating,
  cd_dep_count,
  cd_dep_employed_count,
  cd_dep_college_count
ORDER BY
  cd_gender,
  cd_marital_status,
  cd_education_status,
  cd_purchase_estimate,
  cd_credit_rating,
  cd_dep_count,
  cd_dep_employed_count,
  cd_dep_college_count
LIMIT 100

select avg(ss_quantity), avg(ss_ext_sales_price), avg(ss_ext_wholesale_cost), sum(ss_ext_wholesale_cost)
from store_sales
join store on s_store_sk = ss_store_sk
join date_dim on ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk and d_year = 2001
join household_demographics on ss_hdemo_sk = hd_demo_sk
join customer_demographics on cd_demo_sk = ss_cdemo_sk
join customer_address on ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk and ca_country = 'United States'

  (cd_marital_status = 'U' and cd_education_status = 'College' and ss_sales_price between 100.00 and 150.00 and hd_dep_count = 3)

  or (cd_marital_status = 'S' and cd_education_status = 'College' and ss_sales_price between 150.00 and 200.00 and hd_dep_count = 1)
)
and (
  (ca_state in ('IN', 'NM', 'VA') and ss_net_profit between 100 and 200)
  or (ca_state in ('MT', 'OH', 'OR') and ss_net_profit between 150 and 300)
  or (ca_state in ('GA', 'IL', 'TX') and ss_net_profit between 50 and 250)

WITH date_filtered AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_year = 2001
),
base_joined AS (
  SELECT 
    ss_quantity,
    ss_ext_sales_price,
    ss_ext_wholesale_cost,
    ss_sales_price,
    ss_net_profit,
    cd_education_status,
    hd_dep_count,
    ca_state
  FROM store_sales
  JOIN store ON s_store_sk = ss_store_sk
  JOIN date_filtered ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  JOIN customer_demographics ON cd_demo_sk = ss_cdemo_sk AND cd_marital_status = 'S'
  JOIN household_demographics ON ss_hdemo_sk = hd_demo_sk
  JOIN customer_address ON ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_country = 'United States'
  WHERE ca_state IN ('MS', 'NY', 'VA', 'TN', 'TX', 'NC', 'NM', 'OK')
)
SELECT 
  AVG(ss_quantity),
  AVG(ss_ext_sales_price),
  AVG(ss_ext_wholesale_cost),
  SUM(ss_ext_wholesale_cost)
FROM (
  SELECT ss_quantity, ss_ext_sales_price, ss_ext_wholesale_cost
  FROM base_joined
  WHERE cd_education_status = 'Secondary'
    AND ss_sales_price BETWEEN 100.00 AND 150.00
    AND hd_dep_count = 3
    AND ca_state IN ('MS', 'NY', 'VA')
    AND ss_net_profit BETWEEN 100 AND 200
  UNION ALL

WITH week_seq_values AS (
  SELECT 
    MAX(d_week_seq) FILTER (WHERE d_year = 1999 AND d_moy = 12 AND d_dom = 5) AS week_seq_1999,
    MAX(d_week_seq) FILTER (WHERE d_year = 1998 AND d_moy = 12 AND d_dom = 5) AS week_seq_1998
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE (d_year = 1999 AND d_moy = 12 AND d_dom = 5) OR (d_year = 1998 AND d_moy = 12 AND d_dom = 5)
),
filtered_items AS (
  SELECT i_item_sk, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id
  FROM item
  WHERE i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Jewelry') AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 28 AND 37
),
cross_items AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fi.i_item_sk AS ss_item_sk
  FROM filtered_items fi
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT iss.i_brand_id, iss.i_class_id, iss.i_category_id
    FROM store_sales
    INNER JOIN filtered_items iss ON store_sales.ss_item_sk = iss.i_item_sk
    INNER JOIN date_dim d1 ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
    WHERE d1.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000 AND store_sales.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
  ) ss_data ON fi.i_brand_id = ss_data.i_brand_id AND fi.i_class_id = ss_data.i_class_id AND fi.i_category_id = ss_data.i_category_id
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT ics.i_brand_id, ics.i_class_id, ics.i_category_id
    FROM catalog_sales
    INNER JOIN filtered_items ics ON catalog_sales.cs_item_sk = ics.i_item_sk
    INNER JOIN date_dim d2 ON catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
    WHERE d2.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000 AND catalog_sales.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
  ) cs_data ON fi.i_brand_id = cs_data.i_brand_id AND fi.i_class_id = cs_data.i_class_id AND fi.i_category_id = cs_data.i_category_id
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT iws.i_brand_id, iws.i_class_id, iws.i_category_id
    FROM web_sales
    INNER JOIN filtered_items iws ON web_sales.ws_item_sk = iws.i_item_sk
    INNER JOIN date_dim d3 ON web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk
    WHERE d3.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000 AND web_sales.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
  ) ws_data ON fi.i_brand_id = ws_data.i_brand_id AND fi.i_class_id = ws_data.i_class_id AND fi.i_category_id = ws_data.i_category_id
),
avg_sales AS (
  SELECT avg(quantity * list_price) AS average_sales
  FROM (
    SELECT ss_quantity AS quantity, ss_list_price AS list_price
    FROM store_sales
    INNER JOIN date_dim ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
    WHERE date_dim.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000 AND store_sales.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
    UNION ALL
    SELECT cs_quantity AS quantity, cs_list_price AS list_price
    FROM catalog_sales
    INNER JOIN date_dim ON catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
    WHERE date_dim.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000 AND catalog_sales.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ws_quantity AS quantity, ws_list_price AS list_price
    FROM web_sales
    INNER JOIN date_dim ON web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
    WHERE date_dim.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000 AND web_sales.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
  ) x
),
this_year AS (
  SELECT 
    i.i_brand_id,
    i.i_class_id,
    i.i_category_id,
    SUM(ss.ss_quantity * ss.ss_list_price) AS ty_sales,
    COUNT(*) AS ty_number_sales
  FROM store_sales ss
  INNER JOIN cross_items ci ON ss.ss_item_sk = ci.ss_item_sk
  INNER JOIN filtered_items i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  INNER JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  CROSS JOIN week_seq_values wsv
  WHERE d.d_week_seq = wsv.week_seq_1999 AND ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
  GROUP BY i.i_brand_id, i.i_class_id, i.i_category_id
  HAVING SUM(ss.ss_quantity * ss.ss_list_price) > (SELECT average_sales FROM avg_sales)
),
last_year AS (
  SELECT 
    i.i_brand_id,
    i.i_class_id,
    i.i_category_id,
    SUM(ss.ss_quantity * ss.ss_list_price) AS ly_sales,
    COUNT(*) AS ly_number_sales
  FROM store_sales ss
  INNER JOIN cross_items ci ON ss.ss_item_sk = ci.ss_item_sk
  INNER JOIN filtered_items i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  INNER JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  CROSS JOIN week_seq_values wsv
  WHERE d.d_week_seq = wsv.week_seq_1998 AND ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
  GROUP BY i.i_brand_id, i.i_class_id, i.i_category_id
  HAVING SUM(ss.ss_quantity * ss.ss_list_price) > (SELECT average_sales FROM avg_sales)
)
SELECT 
  'store' AS ty_channel,
  this_year.i_brand_id AS ty_brand,
  this_year.i_class_id AS ty_class,
  this_year.i_category_id AS ty_category,
  this_year.ty_sales,
  this_year.ty_number_sales,
  'store' AS ly_channel,
  last_year.i_brand_id AS ly_brand,
  last_year.i_class_id AS ly_class,
  last_year.i_category_id AS ly_category,
  last_year.ly_sales,
  last_year.ly_number_sales
FROM this_year
INNER JOIN last_year ON this_year.i_brand_id = last_year.i_brand_id AND this_year.i_class_id = last_year.i_class_id AND this_year.i_category_id = last_year.i_category_id
ORDER BY ty_channel, ty_brand, ty_class, ty_category
LIMIT 100

target_week_1999 AS (

),
target_week_1998 AS (
  SELECT d_week_seq
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_year = 1998 AND d_moy = 12 AND d_dom = 13
  LIMIT 1
),
date_range AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk, d_week_seq
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
),
filtered_item_web AS (
  SELECT i_item_sk, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id
  FROM item
  WHERE i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')
    AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 14 AND 23
),
cross_items AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id
  FROM (
    SELECT fi.i_brand_id, fi.i_class_id, fi.i_category_id, 'store' AS channel
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN filtered_item fi ON ss.ss_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
    JOIN date_range dr ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
    WHERE ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 78 AND 98

    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN filtered_item fi ON cs.cs_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
    JOIN date_range dr ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
    WHERE cs.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 78 AND 98
    UNION ALL
    SELECT fi.i_brand_id, fi.i_class_id, fi.i_category_id, 'web' AS channel

    WHERE ws.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 78 AND 98

),
avg_sales_components AS (

  JOIN date_range dr ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
  WHERE ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 78 AND 98
  UNION ALL
  SELECT cs.cs_quantity * cs.cs_list_price AS sales_amount
  FROM catalog_sales cs
  JOIN date_range dr ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
  WHERE cs.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 78 AND 98
  UNION ALL
  SELECT ws.ws_quantity * ws.ws_list_price AS sales_amount

  JOIN date_range dr ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
  WHERE ws.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 78 AND 98
),

  GROUP BY fi.i_brand_id, fi.i_class_id, fi.i_category_id

       this_year.i_category_id AS ty_category,

week_seqs AS (
  SELECT 
    MAX(CASE WHEN d_year = 1999 AND d_moy = 12 AND d_dom = 9 THEN d_week_seq END) AS week_seq_1999,
    MAX(CASE WHEN d_year = 1998 AND d_moy = 12 AND d_dom = 9 THEN d_week_seq END) AS week_seq_1998

),
cross_items AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fi.i_item_sk AS ss_item_sk

    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d1 ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk AND d1.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
    JOIN item iss ON ss.ss_item_sk = iss.i_item_sk
    WHERE ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 23 AND 43
    INTERSECT

    JOIN date_dim d2 ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk AND d2.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
    JOIN item ics ON cs.cs_item_sk = ics.i_item_sk
    WHERE cs.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 23 AND 43
    INTERSECT
    SELECT iws.i_brand_id, iws.i_class_id, iws.i_category_id
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN date_dim d3 ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk AND d3.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000

),

    SELECT ss.ss_quantity AS quantity, ss.ss_list_price AS list_price

WITH date_filtered AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_year = 2002 AND d_moy = 8
),
item_filtered AS (
  SELECT i_item_sk, i_brand_id, i_brand, i_manufact_id, i_manufact
  FROM item
  WHERE i_category = 'Home'
),
customer_filtered AS (
  SELECT c_customer_sk, c_current_addr_sk

address_filtered AS (

),

filtered_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    ss.ss_item_sk,
    ss.ss_customer_sk,
    ss.ss_store_sk,
    ss.ss_ext_sales_price
  FROM store_sales ss
  JOIN date_filtered d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  JOIN item_filtered i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  WHERE ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
)

  i.i_brand_id AS brand_id,
  i.i_brand AS brand,
  i.i_manufact_id,

JOIN address_filtered ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk

frequent_ss_items AS (

    substring(i_item_desc, 1, 30) AS itemdesc,

  FROM store_sales
  JOIN date_dim_2001 ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk

),
ss_filtered AS (
  SELECT ss_customer_sk, ss_item_sk, ss_ticket_number, ss_store_sk, ss_net_profit, ss_sold_date_sk
  FROM store_sales
  WHERE ss_sold_date_sk IS NOT NULL
),
sr_filtered AS (
  SELECT sr_customer_sk, sr_item_sk, sr_ticket_number, sr_net_loss, sr_returned_date_sk
  FROM store_returns
  WHERE sr_returned_date_sk IS NOT NULL
),
cs_filtered AS (
  SELECT cs_bill_customer_sk, cs_item_sk, cs_net_profit, cs_sold_date_sk
  FROM catalog_sales
  WHERE cs_sold_date_sk IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  i_item_id,
  i_item_desc,
  s_store_id,
  s_store_name,
  SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS store_sales_profit,
  SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS store_returns_loss,
  SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS catalog_sales_profit
FROM ss_filtered ss

JOIN store ON store.s_store_sk = ss.ss_store_sk
JOIN sr_filtered sr ON ss.ss_customer_sk = sr.sr_customer_sk
  AND ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk

JOIN cs_filtered cs ON sr.sr_customer_sk = cs.cs_bill_customer_sk
  AND sr.sr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
JOIN d3_filtered d3 ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk
GROUP BY
  i_item_id,
  i_item_desc,
  s_store_id,
  s_store_name
ORDER BY
  i_item_id,
  i_item_desc,
  s_store_id,
  s_store_name

  FROM store_sales
  WHERE ss_sold_date_sk IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT i_item_id, i_item_desc, s_store_id, s_store_name,
       MIN(ss.ss_net_profit) AS store_sales_profit,
       MIN(sr.sr_net_loss) AS store_returns_loss,
       MIN(cs.cs_net_profit) AS catalog_sales_profit
FROM ss_filtered ss
JOIN d1_filtered d1 ON d1.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
JOIN item ON item.i_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
JOIN store ON store.s_store_sk = ss.ss_store_sk
JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
                      AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
                      AND sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
                      AND sr.sr_returned_date_sk IS NOT NULL
JOIN d2_d3_filtered d2 ON d2.d_date_sk = sr.sr_returned_date_sk
JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = sr.sr_customer_sk
                      AND cs.cs_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
                      AND cs.cs_sold_date_sk IS NOT NULL
JOIN d2_d3_filtered d3 ON d3.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
GROUP BY i_item_id, i_item_desc, s_store_id, s_store_name
ORDER BY i_item_id, i_item_desc, s_store_id, s_store_name
LIMIT 100

WITH d1_filtered AS (

d3_filtered AS (

  FROM date_dim

)
SELECT
  MIN(i_item_id),
  MIN(i_item_desc),
  MIN(s_store_id),
  MIN(s_store_name),
  MIN(ss_net_profit),
  MIN(sr_net_loss),
  MIN(cs_net_profit),
  MIN(ss_item_sk),
  MIN(sr_ticket_number),
  MIN(cs_order_number)
FROM
  (
    SELECT
      ss.ss_item_sk,
      ss.ss_customer_sk,
      ss.ss_ticket_number,
      ss.ss_store_sk,
      ss.ss_net_profit
    FROM store_sales ss
    INNER JOIN d1_filtered d1 ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
    WHERE ss.ss_sold_date_sk IS NOT NULL
  ) ss
  INNER JOIN
  (
    SELECT
      sr.sr_item_sk,
      sr.sr_customer_sk,
      sr.sr_ticket_number,
      sr.sr_net_loss
    FROM store_returns sr
    INNER JOIN d2_filtered d2 ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
    WHERE sr.sr_returned_date_sk IS NOT NULL
      AND sr.sr_item_sk IS NOT NULL
      AND sr.sr_customer_sk IS NOT NULL
      AND sr.sr_ticket_number IS NOT NULL
  ) sr
  ON ss.ss_customer_sk = sr.sr_customer_sk
    AND ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
    AND ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number
  INNER JOIN
  (
    SELECT
      cs.cs_bill_customer_sk,
      cs.cs_item_sk,
      cs.cs_order_number,
      cs.cs_net_profit
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    INNER JOIN d3_filtered d3 ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk
    WHERE cs.cs_sold_date_sk IS NOT NULL
      AND cs.cs_bill_customer_sk IS NOT NULL
      AND cs.cs_item_sk IS NOT NULL
  ) cs
  ON sr.sr_customer_sk = cs.cs_bill_customer_sk
    AND sr.sr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
  INNER JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  INNER JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
WHERE
  ss.ss_item_sk IS NOT NULL
  AND ss.ss_customer_sk IS NOT NULL
  AND ss.ss_ticket_number IS NOT NULL
  AND ss.ss_store_sk IS NOT NULL;

  FROM web_returns
  JOIN date_dim ON wr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 2001
  JOIN item ON wr_item_sk = i_item_sk AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 69 AND 78

WITH customer_total_return AS (
  SELECT 
    wr_returning_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk,
    ca_state AS ctr_state,
    wr_reason_sk AS ctr_reason_sk,
    SUM(wr_return_amt) AS ctr_total_return
  FROM (
    SELECT 
      wr.wr_returning_customer_sk,
      wr.wr_reason_sk,
      wr.wr_return_amt,
      ca.ca_state
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN (
      SELECT d_date_sk 
      FROM date_dim 
      WHERE d_year = 1998
    ) d ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN (
      SELECT i_item_sk 
      FROM item 
      WHERE i_manager_id BETWEEN 40 AND 49
    ) i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN (
      SELECT ca_address_sk, ca_state 
      FROM customer_address 
      WHERE ca_state IN ('IN', 'KS', 'NE', 'VA')
    ) ca ON wr.wr_returning_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    WHERE wr.wr_return_amt / wr.wr_return_quantity BETWEEN 3 AND 32
      AND wr.wr_reason_sk IN (11, 18)
  ) filtered_data
  GROUP BY wr_returning_customer_sk, ca_state, wr_reason_sk
)
SELECT 
  c.c_customer_id,
  c.c_salutation,
  c.c_first_name,
  c.c_last_name,
  c.c_preferred_cust_flag,
  c.c_birth_day,
  c.c_birth_month,
  c.c_birth_year,
  c.c_birth_country,
  c.c_login,
  c.c_email_address,
  c.c_last_review_date_sk,
  ctr1.ctr_total_return
FROM customer_total_return ctr1
JOIN (
  SELECT 
    c_customer_sk,
    c_current_addr_sk,
    c_customer_id,
    c_salutation,
    c_first_name,
    c_last_name,
    c_preferred_cust_flag,
    c_birth_day,
    c_birth_month,
    c_birth_year,
    c_birth_country,
    c_login,
    c_email_address,
    c_last_review_date_sk
  FROM customer
  WHERE c_birth_year BETWEEN 1937 AND 1943
) c ON ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_address ca ON ca.ca_address_sk = c.c_current_addr_sk AND ca.ca_state IN ('IN', 'KS', 'NE', 'VA')
WHERE ctr1.ctr_total_return > (
  SELECT AVG(ctr_total_return) * 1.2
  FROM customer_total_return ctr2
  WHERE ctr1.ctr_state = ctr2.ctr_state
)
ORDER BY c_customer_id, c_salutation, c_first_name, c_last_name, c_preferred_cust_flag,
         c_birth_day, c_birth_month, c_birth_year, c_birth_country, c_login, c_email_address,
         c_last_review_date_sk, ctr_total_return
LIMIT 100;

original_query: with inv as (select w_warehouse_name,w_warehouse_sk,i_item_sk,d_moy        ,stdev,mean, case mean when 0 then null else stdev/mean end cov  from(select w_warehouse_name,w_warehouse_sk,i_item_sk,d_moy             ,stddev_samp(inv_quantity_on_hand) stdev,avg(inv_quantity_on_hand) mean       from inventory           ,item           ,warehouse           ,date_dim       where inv_item_sk = i_item_sk         and inv_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk         and inv_date_sk = d_date_sk         and d_year =1998         and i_category IN ('Books', 'Home')         and i_manager_id BETWEEN 28 and 47         and inv_quantity_on_hand between 225 and 425       group by w_warehouse_name,w_warehouse_sk,i_item_sk,d_moy) foo  where case mean when 0 then 0 else stdev/mean end > 1) select inv1.w_warehouse_sk,inv1.i_item_sk,inv1.d_moy,inv1.mean, inv1.cov         ,inv2.w_warehouse_sk,inv2.i_item_sk,inv2.d_moy,inv2.mean, inv2.cov from inv inv1,inv inv2 where inv1.i_item_sk = inv2.i_item_sk   and inv1.w_warehouse_sk =  inv2.w_warehouse_sk   and inv1.d_moy=2   and inv2.d_moy=2+1 order by inv1.w_warehouse_sk,inv1.i_item_sk,inv1.d_moy,inv1.mean,inv1.cov         ,inv2.d_moy,inv2.mean, inv2.cov ;

WITH inv AS (
  SELECT w_warehouse_name, w_warehouse_sk, i_item_sk, d_moy,
         stddev_samp(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS stdev,
         avg(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS mean,
         CASE avg(inv_quantity_on_hand) WHEN 0 THEN NULL ELSE stddev_samp(inv_quantity_on_hand)/avg(inv_quantity_on_hand) END AS cov
  FROM inventory
  JOIN (
    SELECT i_item_sk
    FROM item
    WHERE i_category IN ('Books', 'Home')
      AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 28 AND 47
  ) AS filtered_item ON inv_item_sk = filtered_item.i_item_sk
  JOIN warehouse ON inv_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk
  JOIN (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_moy
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 1998
  ) AS filtered_date ON inv_date_sk = filtered_date.d_date_sk
  WHERE inv_quantity_on_hand BETWEEN 225 AND 425
  GROUP BY w_warehouse_name, w_warehouse_sk, i_item_sk, d_moy
  HAVING CASE avg(inv_quantity_on_hand) WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE stddev_samp(inv_quantity_on_hand)/avg(inv_quantity_on_hand) END > 1
)
SELECT inv1.w_warehouse_sk, inv1.i_item_sk, inv1.d_moy, inv1.mean, inv1.cov,
       inv2.w_warehouse_sk, inv2.i_item_sk, inv2.d_moy, inv2.mean, inv2.cov
FROM inv inv1
JOIN inv inv2 ON inv1.i_item_sk = inv2.i_item_sk
  AND inv1.w_warehouse_sk = inv2.w_warehouse_sk
  AND inv1.d_moy = 2
  AND inv2.d_moy = 3
ORDER BY inv1.w_warehouse_sk, inv1.i_item_sk, inv1.d_moy, inv1.mean, inv1.cov,
         inv2.d_moy, inv2.mean, inv2.cov

SELECT inv1.w_warehouse_sk, inv1.i_item_sk, inv1.d_moy, inv1.mean, inv1.cov,
       inv2.w_warehouse_sk, inv2.i_item_sk, inv2.d_moy, inv2.mean, inv2.cov
FROM (
  SELECT w_warehouse_name, w_warehouse_sk, i_item_sk, d_moy, stdev, mean,
         CASE WHEN mean = 0 THEN NULL ELSE stdev/mean END AS cov
  FROM (
    SELECT w_warehouse_name, w_warehouse_sk, i_item_sk, d_moy,
           STDDEV_SAMP(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS stdev,
           AVG(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS mean
    FROM inventory
    JOIN item ON inv_item_sk = i_item_sk
      AND i_category IN ('Books', 'Home')
      AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 28 AND 47
    JOIN warehouse ON inv_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN date_dim ON inv_date_sk = d_date_sk

      AND d_moy = 2
    WHERE inv_quantity_on_hand BETWEEN 225 AND 425
    GROUP BY w_warehouse_name, w_warehouse_sk, i_item_sk, d_moy
  ) foo
  WHERE CASE WHEN mean = 0 THEN 0 ELSE stdev/mean END > 1
) inv1
JOIN (
  SELECT w_warehouse_name, w_warehouse_sk, i_item_sk, d_moy, stdev, mean,
         CASE WHEN mean = 0 THEN NULL ELSE stdev/mean END AS cov
  FROM (
    SELECT w_warehouse_name, w_warehouse_sk, i_item_sk, d_moy,
           STDDEV_SAMP(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS stdev,
           AVG(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS mean
    FROM inventory
    JOIN item ON inv_item_sk = i_item_sk
      AND i_category IN ('Books', 'Home')
      AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 28 AND 47
    JOIN warehouse ON inv_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk

    WHERE inv_quantity_on_hand BETWEEN 225 AND 425

) inv2 ON inv1.i_item_sk = inv2.i_item_sk
  AND inv1.w_warehouse_sk = inv2.w_warehouse_sk
WHERE inv1.cov > 1.5

    w_warehouse_sk,
    i_item_sk,
    d_moy,
    stddev_samp(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS stdev,
    avg(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS mean
  FROM inventory
  JOIN (
    SELECT i_item_sk
    FROM item
    WHERE i_category IN ('Shoes', 'Sports')
      AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 81 AND 100
  ) AS item_filtered ON inv_item_sk = item_filtered.i_item_sk
  JOIN warehouse ON inv_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk
  JOIN (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_moy
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2001
      AND d_moy IN (1, 2)
  ) AS date_filtered ON inv_date_sk = date_filtered.d_date_sk
  WHERE inv_quantity_on_hand BETWEEN 30 AND 230
  GROUP BY w_warehouse_name, w_warehouse_sk, i_item_sk, d_moy
),
inv AS (
  SELECT 
    w_warehouse_name,
    w_warehouse_sk,
    i_item_sk,
    d_moy,
    stdev,

)

WITH d2_filtered AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_year = 2002 AND d_moy = 8
),
d2_bounds AS (
  SELECT 
    MIN(d_date) - INTERVAL '120' DAY AS min_date,
    MAX(d_date) AS max_date
  FROM d2_filtered
),
d1_range AS (
  SELECT d1.d_date_sk
  FROM date_dim d1
  CROSS JOIN d2_bounds
  WHERE d1.d_date >= d2_bounds.min_date 
    AND d1.d_date <= d2_bounds.max_date
),
store_agg AS (
  SELECT 
    ss_store_sk,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 30) AS days_30,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 30 AND sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 60) AS days_31_60,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 60 AND sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 90) AS days_61_90,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 90 AND sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 120) AS days_91_120,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 120) AS days_gt_120
  FROM store_sales
  JOIN store_returns ON ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number
    AND ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk
    AND ss_customer_sk = sr_customer_sk
  JOIN d2_filtered ON sr_returned_date_sk = d2_filtered.d_date_sk
  JOIN d1_range ON d1_range.d_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk
  GROUP BY ss_store_sk
)
SELECT
  s_store_name,
  s_company_id,
  s_street_number,
  s_street_name,
  s_street_type,
  s_suite_number,
  s_city,
  s_county,
  s_state,
  s_zip,
  store_agg.days_30 AS "30 days",
  store_agg.days_31_60 AS "31-60 days",
  store_agg.days_61_90 AS "61-90 days",
  store_agg.days_91_120 AS "91-120 days",
  store_agg.days_gt_120 AS ">120 days"
FROM store
JOIN store_agg ON s_store_sk = store_agg.ss_store_sk
ORDER BY
  s_store_name,
  s_company_id,
  s_street_number,
  s_street_name,
  s_street_type,
  s_suite_number,
  s_city,

  CAST((revenue / 50) AS int) * 50 AS segment_base
FROM (
  SELECT
    c.c_customer_sk,
    SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS revenue
  FROM
    (
      SELECT DISTINCT

      FROM (
        SELECT

          c.c_current_addr_sk
        FROM catalog_sales cs

        JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk

        WHERE cs.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 18 AND 48
        UNION ALL
        SELECT
          ws.ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
          c.c_current_addr_sk
        FROM web_sales ws
        JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk

        JOIN customer c ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk

        WHERE ws.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 18 AND 48
      ) union_result
    ) my_customers
  JOIN customer c ON my_customers.customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
  JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
  JOIN store s ON ca.ca_county = s.s_county

  GROUP BY c.c_customer_sk

         ad1.ca_street_number AS b_street_number,
         ad1.ca_street_name AS b_street_name,
         ad1.ca_city AS b_city,
         ad1.ca_zip AS b_zip,
         ad2.ca_street_number AS c_street_number,
         ad2.ca_street_name AS c_street_name,
         ad2.ca_city AS c_city,
         ad2.ca_zip AS c_zip,
         d1.d_year AS syear,
         d2.d_year AS fsyear,
         d3.d_year AS s2year,
         COUNT(*) AS cnt,
         SUM(ss.ss_wholesale_cost) AS s1,
         SUM(ss.ss_list_price) AS s2,
         SUM(ss.ss_coupon_amt) AS s3
  FROM (
    SELECT ss_item_sk, ss_ticket_number, ss_store_sk, ss_customer_sk, ss_cdemo_sk, ss_hdemo_sk, ss_addr_sk, ss_promo_sk, ss_wholesale_cost, ss_list_price, ss_coupon_amt, ss_sold_date_sk
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
  ) ss
  JOIN store_returns ON ss.ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk 
                    AND ss.ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number
  JOIN cs_ui ON ss.ss_item_sk = cs_ui.cs_item_sk
  JOIN date_dim d1 ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
  JOIN (
    SELECT s_store_sk, s_store_name, s_zip
    FROM store
  ) s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
  JOIN (
    SELECT p_promo_sk
    FROM promotion
    WHERE p_channel_email = 'Y' AND p_channel_tv = 'Y' AND p_channel_radio = 'Y'
  ) p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
  JOIN (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_product_name
    FROM item
    WHERE i_current_price BETWEEN 1 AND 11
  ) i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
  JOIN date_dim d2 ON c.c_first_sales_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
  JOIN date_dim d3 ON c.c_first_shipto_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk
  JOIN (
    SELECT cd_demo_sk, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status
    FROM customer_demographics
    WHERE cd_marital_status IN ('W', 'D') AND cd_education_status IN ('College', '4 yr Degree')
  ) cd1 ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd1.cd_demo_sk
  JOIN (
    SELECT cd_demo_sk, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status
    FROM customer_demographics
    WHERE cd_marital_status IN ('W', 'D') AND cd_education_status IN ('College', '4 yr Degree')
  ) cd2 ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd2.cd_demo_sk AND cd1.cd_marital_status <> cd2.cd_marital_status
  JOIN household_demographics hd1 ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd1.hd_demo_sk
  JOIN household_demographics hd2 ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd2.hd_demo_sk
  JOIN customer_address ad1 ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ad1.ca_address_sk

    SELECT ca_address_sk, ca_street_number, ca_street_name, ca_city, ca_zip, ca_state

  JOIN income_band ib1 ON hd1.hd_income_band_sk = ib1.ib_income_band_sk
  JOIN income_band ib2 ON hd2.hd_income_band_sk = ib2.ib_income_band_sk
  GROUP BY i_product_name, i_item_sk, s_store_name, s_zip,
           ad1.ca_street_number, ad1.ca_street_name, ad1.ca_city, ad1.ca_zip,
           ad2.ca_street_number, ad2.ca_street_name, ad2.ca_city, ad2.ca_zip,
           d1.d_year, d2.d_year, d3.d_year
)
SELECT cs1.product_name,
       cs1.store_name,
       cs1.store_zip,
       cs1.b_street_number,
       cs1.b_street_name,
       cs1.b_city,

       cs2.s1 AS s12,
       cs2.s2 AS s22,
       cs2.s3 AS s32,
       cs2.syear,
       cs2.cnt
FROM cross_sales cs1

  INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd2 ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd2.cd_demo_sk AND cd2.cd_marital_status IN ('U', 'D', 'W') AND cd2.cd_education_status IN ('Secondary', '4 yr Degree', '2 yr Degree') AND cd1.cd_demo_sk <> cd2.cd_demo_sk
  INNER JOIN household_demographics hd1 ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd1.hd_demo_sk

  INNER JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk AND p.p_channel_email = 'N' AND p.p_channel_tv = 'N' AND p.p_channel_radio = 'Y'

  WHERE ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 45 AND 65
  GROUP BY i.i_item_sk, i.i_product_name, s.s_store_name, s.s_zip, ad1.ca_street_number, ad1.ca_street_name, ad1.ca_city, ad1.ca_zip, ad2.ca_street_number, ad2.ca_street_name, ad2.ca_city, ad2.ca_zip, d2.d_year, d3.d_year

  INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd2 ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd2.cd_demo_sk AND cd2.cd_marital_status IN ('U', 'D', 'W') AND cd2.cd_education_status IN ('Secondary', '4 yr Degree', '2 yr Degree') AND cd1.cd_demo_sk <> cd2.cd_demo_sk
  INNER JOIN household_demographics hd1 ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd1.hd_demo_sk
  INNER JOIN household_demographics hd2 ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd2.hd_demo_sk
  INNER JOIN customer_address ad1 ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ad1.ca_address_sk

  JOIN customer_address ad2 ON ad2.ca_state IN ('KS', 'MN', 'NV')
  JOIN customer ON ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk AND c_current_addr_sk = ad2.ca_address_sk
  JOIN date_dim d2 ON c_first_sales_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
  JOIN date_dim d3 ON c_first_shipto_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk
  JOIN customer_demographics cd1 ON ss_cdemo_sk = cd1.cd_demo_sk AND cd1.cd_marital_status IN ('D', 'U', 'S') AND cd1.cd_education_status IN ('College', 'Advanced Degree')
  JOIN customer_demographics cd2 ON c_current_cdemo_sk = cd2.cd_demo_sk AND cd2.cd_marital_status IN ('D', 'U', 'S') AND cd2.cd_education_status IN ('College', 'Advanced Degree') AND cd1.cd_marital_status <> cd2.cd_marital_status

  WHERE i_current_price BETWEEN 17 AND 27

)

WITH all_sales AS (
  SELECT
    d_year,
    i_brand_id,
    i_class_id,
    i_category_id,
    i_manufact_id,
    SUM(cs_quantity) - SUM(COALESCE(cr_return_quantity, 0)) AS sales_cnt,
    SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) - SUM(COALESCE(cr_return_amount, 0.0)) AS sales_amt
  FROM
    catalog_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON d_date_sk = cs_sold_date_sk AND d_year IN (1998, 1999)
    JOIN item ON i_item_sk = cs_item_sk AND i_category = 'Sports'
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns ON (
      cs_order_number = cr_order_number
      AND cs_item_sk = cr_item_sk
    )
  WHERE
    cs_sales_price >= 0.80 * cs_list_price
    AND cs_sales_price <= cs_list_price
    AND (cr_reason_sk IN (7, 10, 12, 29, 45) OR cr_reason_sk IS NULL)
  GROUP BY
    d_year,
    i_brand_id,
    i_class_id,
    i_category_id,
    i_manufact_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    d_year,
    i_brand_id,
    i_class_id,
    i_category_id,
    i_manufact_id,
    SUM(ss_quantity) - SUM(COALESCE(sr_return_quantity, 0)) AS sales_cnt,
    SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) - SUM(COALESCE(sr_return_amt, 0.0)) AS sales_amt
  FROM
    store_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON d_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk AND d_year IN (1998, 1999)
    JOIN item ON i_item_sk = ss_item_sk AND i_category = 'Sports'
    LEFT JOIN store_returns ON (
      ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number
      AND ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk
    )
  WHERE
    ss_sales_price >= 0.80 * ss_list_price
    AND ss_sales_price <= ss_list_price
    AND (sr_reason_sk IN (7, 10, 12, 29, 45) OR sr_reason_sk IS NULL)
  GROUP BY
    d_year,
    i_brand_id,
    i_class_id,
    i_category_id,
    i_manufact_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    d_year,
    i_brand_id,
    i_class_id,
    i_category_id,
    i_manufact_id,
    SUM(ws_quantity) - SUM(COALESCE(wr_return_quantity, 0)) AS sales_cnt,
    SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) - SUM(COALESCE(wr_return_amt, 0.0)) AS sales_amt
  FROM
    web_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON d_date_sk = ws_sold_date_sk AND d_year IN (1998, 1999)
    JOIN item ON i_item_sk = ws_item_sk AND i_category = 'Sports'
    LEFT JOIN web_returns ON (
      ws_order_number = wr_order_number
      AND ws_item_sk = wr_item_sk
    )
  WHERE
    ws_sales_price >= 0.80 * ws_list_price
    AND ws_sales_price <= ws_list_price
    AND (wr_reason_sk IN (7, 10, 12, 29, 45) OR wr_reason_sk IS NULL)
  GROUP BY
    d_year,
    i_brand_id,
    i_class_id,
    i_category_id,
    i_manufact_id
)
SELECT
  1998 AS prev_year,
  1999 AS year,
  curr_yr.i_brand_id,
  curr_yr.i_class_id,
  curr_yr.i_category_id,
  curr_yr.i_manufact_id,
  prev_yr.sales_cnt AS prev_yr_cnt,
  curr_yr.sales_cnt AS curr_yr_cnt,
  curr_yr.sales_cnt - prev_yr.sales_cnt AS sales_cnt_diff,
  curr_yr.sales_amt - prev_yr.sales_amt AS sales_amt_diff
FROM
  (
    SELECT
      i_brand_id,
      i_class_id,
      i_category_id,
      i_manufact_id,
      SUM(sales_cnt) AS sales_cnt,
      SUM(sales_amt) AS sales_amt
    FROM all_sales
    WHERE d_year = 1999
    GROUP BY
      i_brand_id,
      i_class_id,
      i_category_id,
      i_manufact_id
  ) curr_yr
  JOIN (
    SELECT
      i_brand_id,
      i_class_id,
      i_category_id,
      i_manufact_id,
      SUM(sales_cnt) AS sales_cnt,
      SUM(sales_amt) AS sales_amt
    FROM all_sales
    WHERE d_year = 1998
    GROUP BY
      i_brand_id,
      i_class_id,
      i_category_id,
      i_manufact_id
  ) prev_yr ON (
    curr_yr.i_brand_id = prev_yr.i_brand_id
    AND curr_yr.i_class_id = prev_yr.i_class_id
    AND curr_yr.i_category_id = prev_yr.i_category_id
    AND curr_yr.i_manufact_id = prev_yr.i_manufact_id
  )
WHERE
  prev_yr.sales_cnt > 0
  AND CAST(curr_yr.sales_cnt AS DECIMAL(17, 2)) / CAST(prev_yr.sales_cnt AS DECIMAL(17, 2)) < 0.9
ORDER BY
  sales_cnt_diff,
  sales_amt_diff
LIMIT 100;

WITH all_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    d_year,
    i_brand_id,
    i_class_id,
    i_category_id,
    i_manufact_id,
    SUM(cs_quantity - COALESCE(cr_return_quantity, 0)) AS sales_cnt,
    SUM(cs_ext_sales_price - COALESCE(cr_return_amount, 0.0)) AS sales_amt
  FROM catalog_sales
  JOIN item ON i_item_sk = cs_item_sk AND i_category = 'Women'
  JOIN date_dim ON d_date_sk = cs_sold_date_sk AND d_year IN (2001, 2002)
  LEFT JOIN catalog_returns ON cs_order_number = cr_order_number 
    AND cs_item_sk = cr_item_sk
  WHERE cs_sales_price BETWEEN 0.68 * cs_list_price AND 0.88 * cs_list_price
    AND (cr_order_number IS NULL OR cr_reason_sk IN (9, 19, 23, 33, 44))
  GROUP BY d_year, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, i_manufact_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    d_year,
    i_brand_id,
    i_class_id,
    i_category_id,
    i_manufact_id,
    SUM(ss_quantity - COALESCE(sr_return_quantity, 0)) AS sales_cnt,
    SUM(ss_ext_sales_price - COALESCE(sr_return_amt, 0.0)) AS sales_amt
  FROM store_sales
  JOIN item ON i_item_sk = ss_item_sk AND i_category = 'Women'
  JOIN date_dim ON d_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk AND d_year IN (2001, 2002)
  LEFT JOIN store_returns ON ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number 
    AND ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk
  WHERE ss_sales_price BETWEEN 0.68 * ss_list_price AND 0.88 * ss_list_price
    AND (sr_ticket_number IS NULL OR sr_reason_sk IN (9, 19, 23, 33, 44))
  GROUP BY d_year, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, i_manufact_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    d_year,
    i_brand_id,
    i_class_id,
    i_category_id,
    i_manufact_id,
    SUM(ws_quantity - COALESCE(wr_return_quantity, 0)) AS sales_cnt,
    SUM(ws_ext_sales_price - COALESCE(wr_return_amt, 0.0)) AS sales_amt
  FROM web_sales
  JOIN item ON i_item_sk = ws_item_sk AND i_category = 'Women'
  JOIN date_dim ON d_date_sk = ws_sold_date_sk AND d_year IN (2001, 2002)
  LEFT JOIN web_returns ON ws_order_number = wr_order_number 
    AND ws_item_sk = wr_item_sk
  WHERE ws_sales_price BETWEEN 0.68 * ws_list_price AND 0.88 * ws_list_price
    AND (wr_order_number IS NULL OR wr_reason_sk IN (9, 19, 23, 33, 44))
  GROUP BY d_year, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, i_manufact_id
)
SELECT 
  prev_yr.d_year AS prev_year,
  curr_yr.d_year AS year,
  curr_yr.i_brand_id,
  curr_yr.i_class_id,
  curr_yr.i_category_id,
  curr_yr.i_manufact_id,
  prev_yr.sales_cnt AS prev_yr_cnt,
  curr_yr.sales_cnt AS curr_yr_cnt,
  curr_yr.sales_cnt - prev_yr.sales_cnt AS sales_cnt_diff,
  curr_yr.sales_amt - prev_yr.sales_amt AS sales_amt_diff
FROM (
  SELECT d_year, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, i_manufact_id, 
         SUM(sales_cnt) AS sales_cnt, SUM(sales_amt) AS sales_amt
  FROM all_sales
  WHERE d_year = 2002
  GROUP BY d_year, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, i_manufact_id
) curr_yr
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT d_year, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, i_manufact_id, 
         SUM(sales_cnt) AS sales_cnt, SUM(sales_amt) AS sales_amt
  FROM all_sales
  WHERE d_year = 2001
  GROUP BY d_year, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, i_manufact_id
) prev_yr
  ON curr_yr.i_brand_id = prev_yr.i_brand_id
  AND curr_yr.i_class_id = prev_yr.i_class_id
  AND curr_yr.i_category_id = prev_yr.i_category_id
  AND curr_yr.i_manufact_id = prev_yr.i_manufact_id
WHERE prev_yr.sales_cnt > 0
  AND CAST(curr_yr.sales_cnt AS DECIMAL(17, 2)) / CAST(prev_yr.sales_cnt AS DECIMAL(17, 2)) < 0.9
ORDER BY sales_cnt_diff, sales_amt_diff
LIMIT 100

  SELECT

    ca_state AS ctr_state,

  FROM catalog_returns
  JOIN date_dim ON cr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1998
  JOIN customer_address ON cr_returning_addr_sk = ca_address_sk
  GROUP BY cr_returning_customer_sk, ca_state
),

  FROM customer_total_return

)
SELECT 
  c_customer_id,

  c_first_name,
  c_last_name,
  ca_street_number,

  ctr1.ctr_total_return
FROM customer_total_return ctr1
JOIN state_avg sa ON ctr1.ctr_state = sa.ctr_state AND ctr1.ctr_total_return > sa.threshold
JOIN customer ON ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_address ON ca_address_sk = c_current_addr_sk AND ca_state = 'IL'

WITH eligible_dates AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d_date_sk
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_date IN ('2002-02-09','2002-04-16','2002-07-16','2002-10-28')
),
filtered_item AS (
  SELECT i_item_sk, i_item_id
  FROM item
  WHERE i_category IN ('Home', 'Jewelry')
    AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 91 AND 100
),
sr_agg AS (
  SELECT i.i_item_id AS item_id,
         SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS sr_item_qty
  FROM store_returns sr
  JOIN eligible_dates ed ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = ed.d_date_sk
  JOIN filtered_item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  WHERE sr.sr_reason_sk IN (3, 20, 40, 43, 51)
    AND sr.sr_return_amt / sr.sr_return_quantity BETWEEN 271 AND 300
  GROUP BY i.i_item_id
),
cr_agg AS (
  SELECT i.i_item_id AS item_id,
         SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS cr_item_qty
  FROM catalog_returns cr
  JOIN eligible_dates ed ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = ed.d_date_sk
  JOIN filtered_item i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  WHERE cr.cr_reason_sk IN (3, 20, 40, 43, 51)
    AND cr.cr_return_amount / cr.cr_return_quantity BETWEEN 271 AND 300
  GROUP BY i.i_item_id
),
wr_agg AS (
  SELECT i.i_item_id AS item_id,
         SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS wr_item_qty
  FROM web_returns wr
  JOIN eligible_dates ed ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = ed.d_date_sk
  JOIN filtered_item i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  WHERE wr.wr_reason_sk IN (3, 20, 40, 43, 51)
    AND wr.wr_return_amt / wr.wr_return_quantity BETWEEN 271 AND 300
  GROUP BY i.i_item_id
)
SELECT sr.item_id,
       sr.sr_item_qty,
       sr.sr_item_qty / (sr.sr_item_qty + cr.cr_item_qty + wr.wr_item_qty) / 3.0 * 100 AS sr_dev,
       cr.cr_item_qty,
       cr.cr_item_qty / (sr.sr_item_qty + cr.cr_item_qty + wr.wr_item_qty) / 3.0 * 100 AS cr_dev,
       wr.wr_item_qty,
       wr.wr_item_qty / (sr.sr_item_qty + cr.cr_item_qty + wr.wr_item_qty) / 3.0 * 100 AS wr_dev,
       (sr.sr_item_qty + cr.cr_item_qty + wr.wr_item_qty) / 3.0 AS average
FROM sr_agg sr
JOIN cr_agg cr ON sr.item_id = cr.item_id
JOIN wr_agg wr ON sr.item_id = wr.item_id
ORDER BY sr.item_id, sr.sr_item_qty
LIMIT 100;
